# What in your app could cost you a fine, a chargeback or a surprise bill?

> A free, local scan for consent, auto-renewal, disclosure, licence, leaked-key and runaway-spend problems, with the law or rule behind each finding. Observations, not legal advice.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/liability-audit/)
